name: ai-game-studio-pixel
description: An opt-in, pinned pixel-art MCP adapter and safety workflow for Codex AI Game Studio.

interface.shortDescription: Plan and operate one pinned pixel-art MCP safely.
interface.longDescription: Detects compatible pixel-art tools, plans the willibrandon pixel MCP adapter, documents Pixelorama and Tiled alternatives, and requires confirmation before asset writes.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $ai-game-studio-pixel:setup-pixel to inspect this sprite workflow and propose a pinned setup. Do not change anything yet.
